schema.title: JSON schema for Foundry VTT template.json files.

description:
Our game’s data model supports three main Actor categories – **character**, **npc**, and **vehicle** – each built upon reusable templates. The foundational **base** template describes a generic actor with a short description (“Base actor template”), a default of 10 hit points, and core attributes set at 10 for Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence. An additional **magical** template adds spellcasting ability, grants a mana pool of 30, and provides spell slots of two Level 1 slots and one Level 2 slot. A **character** combines both the base and magical templates, raising its default hit points to 12, granting proficiency in Athletics and Perception, and assigning a “soldier” background. An **npc** pulls only the base template, is aligned neutral, is not hostile, and carries a challenge rating of 2. The **vehicle** type also inherits the base template, moves at a speed of 60, seats up to 4 occupants, and requires a crew to operate.  

Similarly, the Item schema defines three sub‑types – **weapon**, **armor**, and **consumable** – that share the **equipment** template, which specifies a weight of 2, a value of 50, and a rarity of “common”. A separate **magicalItem** template (rarity “rare”, requires attunement, and is described as “Glows faintly when held.”) is also available for any item that needs magical properties. A **weapon** uses the equipment template and deals 1d8 slashing damage, is marked as versatile, and lists its damage type explicitly. An **armor** entry also references the equipment template, provides an armor class of 15, is of the “medium” type, and does not impose a stealth disadvantage. Finally, a **consumable** adopts the equipment template, is single‑use, produces a healing effect instantly, and notes its consumption method as “single‑use”.
